items.title: Add shared evidence artifact storage primitives for candidate-only artifacts
items.context: Create a minimal reusable evidence artifact envelope/store under packages/main/src/core/evidence following docs/evidence/evidence-platform-architecture.md. It should write immutable artifacts under .lattice/evidence and avoid handler-level direct file writes.
items.userSees: repro_probe stores an immutable candidate-only artifact and prints artifactId, digest, and evidenceScope=candidate-only.

happy.desc: Creating a candidate artifact writes an immutable digest-addressed object and a stable ref under .lattice/evidence.

edge.desc: Writing the same artifact payload is idempotent by digest and does not mutate the stored object.

adversarial.desc: Candidate-only artifacts expose evidenceScope=candidate-only and cannot be classified as production or DONE admissible evidence by this MVP.

items.title: Implement ReproIntakeService candidate workflow
items.context: Implement createProbe, reviewProbe, recordSpike, reviewSpike, createStoryFromRepro, createRedGreenRelation/evaluate basics, and getStage using candidate-only semantics from repro-first-story-intake-experiment.md.
items.userSees: repro_review_set, spike_record, spike_review_set, and red_green_relation_evaluate print candidate stage/status summaries without marking any story DONE.

happy.desc: A reviewed repro plus reviewed spike advances the candidate stage and produces auditable artifact refs.

edge.desc: Red-green relation evaluation fails closed when command digest, expected failure pattern, or reviewed candidate refs do not match.

adversarial.desc: story_create_from_repro only creates a story through the existing story_create path and records a candidate binding; it does not create verificationEvidence or DONE evidence.

items.title: Expose thin CLI handlers and command registry entries
items.context: Add repro_probe, repro_review_set, repro_probe_get, spike_record, spike_review_set, story_create_from_repro, red_green_relation_create, red_green_relation_evaluate, regression_matrix_review_set as thin handlers calling EvidenceRuntime/ReproIntakeService.
items.userSees: lattice --help lists the new repro-first commands and each command returns JSON/text with artifactId, digest, and candidate scope fields.

happy.desc: All new commands are registered in MAIN_TOOLS and the handler registry, and can be invoked through the CLI.

edge.desc: Invalid candidate ids, unreviewed probe refs, or missing story creation fields produce explicit non-zero errors.

adversarial.desc: Handlers reject attempts to pass candidate artifacts as production, authority, or DONE evidence scope.

items.title: Add focused smoke tests for the candidate-only workflow
items.context: Cover red probe creation, review digest binding, spike review, atomic story evidence binding, red-green relation evaluation, matrix-gap blocking semantics as candidate records, and no direct current verificationEvidence creation by story_create_from_repro.
items.userSees: node packages/main/dist/tasks/repro-first-candidate-smoke.js prints repro-first candidate smoke passed with all assertions green.

happy.desc: Smoke covers the full happy path from repro_probe through story_create_from_repro binding.

edge.desc: Smoke covers matrix gaps and red-green mismatch diagnostics as candidate records rather than production gate evidence.

adversarial.desc: Smoke asserts no current story verificationEvidence is created by story_create_from_repro and candidate artifacts remain non-DONE scoped.
